text:
The place was dark and dusty, a lost corner
in a maze of old lanes beside the docks,
smelling of strange things from overseas,
amid curious scraps of fog scattered by the west wind.
Smoke- and frost-clouded diamond panes
barely revealed heaps of books, like twisted trees
rotting from floor to ceiling… traces
of ancient knowledge crumbling at bargain prices.

I entered, spellbound, and from a cobwebbed heap
picked up the nearest volume and read at random,
trembling at strange words that seemed to conceal
some monstrous secret for whoever found it.
Then, searching for an old, sly bookseller,
I found only the echo of a laugh.

translation.title: The Book
